what: Verified knowledge base of the XRP Ledger ECOSYSTEM for a builder — protocol features, transaction types, XLS standards, client libraries & tooling — each tagged with its current mainnet / amendment status. Whole-ecosystem: XRPL mainnet + Xahau/Hooks + the XRPL EVM sidechain + the institutional layer (RLUSD, compliance).
decisive_axis: network_status — is this feature ACTUALLY enabled on XRPL mainnet right now (vs amendment-pending / devnet-only / deprecated), and which standard/library is current — plus which of the four build-focus tracks (game economies / NFT assets / payments / identity-compliance) it serves.

domains.name: Protocol & consensus
domains.description: XRP LCP, validators & UNL, ledger objects, fees & reserves, the XRP asset, the amendment process.

domains.name: Transactions & accounts
domains.description: The transaction model & fields, autofill/sign/submit lifecycle, results & metadata, tickets, multisign, batch, delegation.

domains.name: Tokens & issued assets
domains.description: Issued currencies (IOUs) & trust lines, rippling, freeze/deep-freeze, clawback, Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs).

domains.name: Stablecoins & institutional
domains.description: RLUSD, stablecoin issuance patterns, institutional rails, tokenized RWAs, on-chain compliance building blocks.

domains.name: DEX & AMM
domains.description: Native order-book DEX, auto-bridging, pathfinding, the AMM (XLS-30), permissioned DEX.

domains.name: NFTs
domains.description: XLS-20 NFTokens: mint/burn, offers, brokered vs direct sales, royalties, collections, dynamic NFTs.

domains.name: Programmability — Hooks (Xahau)
domains.description: Hooks on the Xahau network: the Hooks API, SetHook, Xahau vs XRPL mainnet, when to use it.

domains.name: Programmability — XRPL EVM sidechain
domains.description: The XRPL EVM sidechain: Solidity contracts, the Axelar bridge, EVM tooling, when to use it vs native XRPL.

top_pick.name: EVM mainnet network parameters (chain ID & RPC)

domains.name: Advanced payments
domains.description: Escrow, payment channels (micropayments), checks, partial & cross-currency payments, destination tags.

domains.name: Identity & compliance
domains.description: DID (XLS-40), Credentials (XLS-70), permissioned domains, deposit auth, account flags, the on-chain KYC toolkit.

domains.name: Client libraries & SDKs
domains.description: xrpl.js, xrpl-py, xrpl4j, ripple-binary-codec, keypairs/signing, wallets, faucets, which lib for which stack.

domains.name: Infrastructure & tooling
domains.description: rippled, Clio, public nodes & data APIs, explorers, wallets, price oracles (XLS-47), indexers, dev networks.
